# 200.00 USD paid to V-US out of the CAD bank as 274.00 CAD, a rate of 1.37,
# against BILL-USD-OVER for 100.00 USD posted at 1.40. The entry divides the
# payable side: 100.00 paying the bill and 100.00 left over.
#
# The paying split pays the bill in Canadian dollars, so it consumes the
# bill's cost basis: it states the bill's posting split, c1c1…, and is valued
# at the 140.00 CAD the bill was carried at. The 137.00 CAD it cost is 3.00
# less, and `Income:FX Gain $residual$` takes the 3.00. The bill's posting is
# stated as the transaction it is, as an export writes it, so its split has a
# guid for the payment to state.
#
# The other 100.00 USD is the vendor's debt to this book, money it holds
# against the next bill: an asset cost basis at the 1.37 the entry values it
# at.
#
# Load after `fx_usd_bill_cad_expense.txt`, with
# `--fx-rates tests/fixtures/fx_rates_usd_dated.yaml`.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_the_credit_an_overpaying_wire_leaves_is_counted_once_however_it_is_divided.py.
